additional_info.subject: ID0406718-DC/Si-D/MY-[MP / ND 170000121] V2G Error with MG4 CRM:00797001729
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-MY Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Siemens Pte Ltd
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / ND 170000121
Charger ID/Serial No.:
sruJwD
Problem Description:
V2G Error with MG4
According to
ISO 15118
, the charger should indeed be capable of informing the vehicle when a charging session is being initiated. This standard facilitates seamless communication between the electric vehicle (EV) and the charging station, ensuring the EV recognizes the start of a charging session rather than mistakenly assuming it is a load or a Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) backward flow.
Regarding the specific timestamp you provided, we have checked the V2G logs, and communication was established according to the
DIN 70121
protocol. It appears that the charging session was unable to progress to the
P02 Parameter Discovery
state because the EV did not send the required parameter data within the allotted time. As a result, the session was terminated.
In the protocol, the charging session passes through various stages, one of which is the
P02 Parameter Discovery
state. During this stage, the charger (EVSE) requests the vehicle to send essential charging parameters, such as the maximum current, voltage, and available power. If the EV does not respond with the necessary data within the expected timeframe, the charger cannot continue with the session, leading to an aborted or terminated session.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
7th Dec. 2023
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
